'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a message whose contents change depending on which ending you obtain at the end of the [[Quests|Beatrice's Offer]] questline.

== Helping Beatrice ==
When you do not betray [[Lady Beatrice]] to [[Koukol]] you will find the '''{{PAGENAME}}''' on one of the 3 [[Corpse|corpses]] that appear in the [[Morgue]].

=== Dialogue ===
After entering the morgue, The Keeper will comment that: "''Mmmm... Donkey never leaves corpses here. How Strange''"<br>
The note will then drop form one of the corpses.

The note then reads: 
{|
|-
| "''A tiny request my dear ~''"
|-
| "''the soldiers refused their injections.''"
|-
| "''Whether they knew the truth or not, keeping them alive was an unnecessary risk.''"
|-
| "''Get rid of the bodies as soon as possible.''"
|-
| "''A thousand kisses, and stay in touch, our work together has just begun!''"
|}

The keeper then comments: "''Oh Crap...''".

''After reading you will immediately receive the [[Perks#Progression_Perks|Industriousness Perk]].''

== Betraying Beatrice ==
When you betray [[Lady Beatrice]] to [[Koukol]] you will find the '''{{PAGENAME}}''' in the [[Donation box]] after performing your next [[Sermon]].

The note reads:
{|
|-
| "''You survived. my dear. What an amazing surprise.''"
|-
| "''You survived - and dash all my plans.''"
|-
| "Not bad! But don't be surprised if your life soon turns into a nightmare."
|-
| "''See you soon.''"
|}

The keeper then comments: "''Well, at least... That's to be expected.''"


After reading you will immediately receive the [[Perks#Progression_Perks|Eloquence Perk]].
